generated_from.accuracy_policy: Claims are grounded in repository files and code paths. Speculative interpretation is separated from observed implementation.

reality: Aegis is implemented as a Rust crate and CLI, a native CEF runtime, and an injected browser-page JavaScript runtime.
The browser is controlled through a persistent local HTTP API served by Rust.
Real browser behavior is executed by CEF in native code, not by a fake DOM or simulated browser model.
Rust communicates with the native host through a dynamically loaded C ABI and a framed protocol with magic AEGS and protocol version 1.
The page runtime turns browser DOM, page state, media state, and interactions into JSON data consumed by Rust.
interpretation: The central architecture is a real-browser control plane, not a browser automation library embedded in a test harness.
The core product boundary is one persistent browser session behind one local control API.
The durable product state is Aegis-owned JSON under ~/.aegis, while Chromium profile behavior is runtime substrate rather than the canonical persistence API.
The injected JS runtime is the semantic lens that makes arbitrary web pages agent-addressable.

contradictions.expectation: A browser automation tool might relaunch a browser per command.
contradictions.evidence: README states one persistent serve process and no production per-command relaunch path; src/main.rs resolves serve as the default non-shortcut command; src/api/server.rs serializes operations through runtime contexts.

contradictions.expectation: DOM ids could be sufficient for automation.
contradictions.evidence: README says semantic match targeting is canonical; src/commands/matcher.rs and assets/js/aegis_runtime.js both implement matcher scoring across role, name, label, text, placeholder, test id, href, control type, tag, actionability, and visibility.

contradictions.expectation: Session persistence could use browser profile directories.
contradictions.evidence: README and docs/agent-control.md state Chromium profiles are not the persistence API; src/state.rs, src/session/profile.rs, and src/config_store.rs implement Aegis-owned JSON state, secrets, and credentials.

contradictions.expectation: The Rust side alone owns the browser model.
contradictions.evidence: src/runtime/executor.rs delegates page execution, snapshots, storage, and live state to CefBridge; native/src/aegis_cef_host.cpp delegates DOM operations to renderer IPC; assets/js/aegis_runtime.js performs semantic page inspection and action execution.

what_the_lamp_reveals: Aegis is best understood as a three-layer browser intelligence stack: Rust control plane, native CEF host, and injected semantic page runtime.
The protocol boundary is intentionally thin and stable: Rust sends typed envelopes; native owns browser lifecycle; JS owns page semantics.
Determinism is pursued above a nondeterministic browser by sequencing events, recording traces, normalizing state, and validating behavior with Fozzy scenarios.
first_principles_frame.better_abstraction: Aegis is a persistent real-browser operating surface for agents. It converts real CEF browser state into a typed, traceable, semantic control API.
what_is_proven: The repository exposes a Rust lib and bin named aegis.
The CLI includes open, version, serve, usage, examples, navigate, search, page, trace, config, and native subcommands.
The HTTP API exposes default-context routes and /contexts/{context_id} scoped equivalents.
The native host exports aegis_create_host, aegis_destroy_host, aegis_last_error_message, and aegis_get_function_table.

The host ABI function table includes ensure_runtime, eval_js, send_batch, snapshot_dom, inject_session, snapshot_session, drain_events, navigate, snapshot_host_state, activate_browser, pump, request_cancel, and free_buffer.

The injected JS runtime installs window.__aegis with snapshot, exec, click, hover, pressKey, setValue, setFiles, scrollToPosition, drag, geometry, drainEvents, currentPageState, resolveTargetInfo, waitState, and pageResearchData.
what_is_still_unknown: Runtime behavior against arbitrary third-party websites can only be fully validated with live host-backed browser runs.
Some CEF and platform behavior depends on the local CEF SDK, OS, signing state, and installed native artifacts.
The architecture file describes source structure and intended behavior, not a guarantee that every route is currently bug-free under all live sites.
next_experiments: Run host-backed Fozzy trace verification after architecture-affecting code changes.
Generate architecture diagrams from the graph_model section and compare against code owner review.
Record a host-backed trace for representative login, download, upload, media, and multi-context workflows.
Add automated schema validation for this architecture file if it becomes a long-lived visualization input.
first_principles_frame.honest_thesis: Aegis is architected as a persistent CEF-backed browser runtime with a Rust API/CLI/control plane and a JS semantic automation runtime injected into every page. Its durable value is the conversion of real browser state into structured, replayable, agent-friendly operations.

layers.name: Rust CLI
responsibilities: Parse user-facing commands and global flags.
Resolve BrowserConfig and transfer directories.
Start serve in foreground or detached mode.
Forward research commands to HTTP API.
Manage config, secrets, credentials, trace inspect, and native commands.
Resolve default native host library from workspace or installed app.

layers.name: Rust HTTP Control Plane
responsibilities: Expose Axum HTTP API.
Manage default and named runtime contexts.
Serialize runtime operations through mpsc channels.
Maintain diagnostics, readiness, doctor, telemetry, and operation failure snapshots.
Expose SSE event streams.
Auto-capture Aegis-owned credentials after username/password entry followed by submit-like command when enabled.

layers.name: Rust Runtime Executor
responsibilities: Wrap the bridge in AegisRuntime and AegisClient.
Sequence command batches and runtime events.
Apply DOM snapshots and incremental DOM mutations.
Execute wait_for and media_state locally with polling.
Refresh live page state from window.__aegis.currentPageState().
Annotate interaction command results with diagnostics from emitted events.
Record traces when enabled.

layers.name: Rust Native Transport
responsibilities: Load the native host dynamic library.
Bind C ABI functions into HostFunctionTable.
Encode and decode framed protocol messages.
Invoke native functions and safely free returned buffers.
Expose LoadedAegisClient and cancellation handle.

layers.name: Native CEF Host
responsibilities: Own CEF lifecycle for the host library runtime.
Create and manage browser instances and request contexts.
Run CEF message pump on the owner thread.
Route Rust protocol operations to CEF and renderer IPC.
Inject session cookies, storage, and network overrides.
Snapshot session, DOM, host state, downloads, and events.
Capture network and websocket events through DevTools Network domain.
Track downloads and emit local download events.
Expose operation stages and structured operation errors.

layers.name: Native CEF App and Renderer Bridge
responsibilities: Configure CEF app behavior, bootstrap scheme, and preferences.
Inject the generated Aegis runtime script into renderer contexts.
Dispatch renderer operations such as ensure runtime, eval JS, snapshot DOM, drain events, and storage operations.
Handle renderer response and lifecycle process messages.
Forward CEF browser callbacks to Aegis host delegate.

layers.name: Injected Page JavaScript Runtime
responsibilities: Install window.__aegis once per page context.
Assign element IDs for the current document lifetime.
Serialize semantic DOM snapshots.
Observe DOM mutations and queue runtime events.
Resolve ID or semantic matcher targets.
Execute synthetic click, hover, set_value, set_files, press_key, scroll, drag, geometry, and eval commands.
Expose current page state, wait state, media diagnostics, bootstrap diagnostics, and page research data.
Track interaction, media, script error, and unhandled rejection logs.

layers.name: Platform Layer
responsibilities: Resolve CEF platform paths.
Configure CEF settings and subprocess paths.
Run platform main entry.
Initialize app/window behavior.
Provide macOS headful browser window chrome and UI.
Handle helper process integration.

node.attrs: allowlisted string attributes plus live value for form elements

semantics.name: optional accessible-ish name
semantics.label: associated label where available
semantics.actionable: true when actions are available and not hidden control

retention.gap_detection: EventReadWindow reports gap_detected when requested sequence is older than retained history.

properties: synthetic timestamps start at 1 and increment per event in Scheduler

validation: Cookie names must not be empty.
Cookie domains must not be empty.
Network override headers must not be empty.
normalization: Cookie domain is trimmed, leading dot removed, lowercased.
Duplicate cookies are deduplicated by normalized name, domain, and path with last value winning.

replay_semantics: Last non-null response snapshot becomes final snapshot.
A navigation event without a snapshot clears final snapshot.
Emitted events are replayed into an unbounded EventStream.

validation: Frame must be at least 16 bytes.
Body length must exactly match frame length.
Envelope kind must match expected kind.

rust_safety_boundaries: src/transport/bridge.rs rejects null or zero-length invalid buffers.
src/transport/bridge.rs caps native returned buffers at 64 MiB.
Native buffers are freed through HostFunctionTable.free_buffer.

native_renderer_ipc.direction: Browser process sends operations to renderer main frame; renderer replies with success boolean and JSON/string body.
native_renderer_ipc.lifecycle_signal: Renderer sends context_ready after runtime script injection.

readiness_policy: Inspectable DOM gate must pass unless document has not loaded, module scripts are absent, or synthetic shell is active.
Failures return structured ApiErrorBody with code and suggested action.

canonical_tree.~/.aegis/settings/runtime.json: Runtime settings, bootstrap_page and persistent mode flags.
canonical_tree.~/.aegis/settings/credentials.json: Aegis-owned credential capture settings, including auto_store.
canonical_tree.~/.aegis/secrets/profiles/<profile>/secr: Versioned profile secrets, including credentials entries.
canonical_tree.~/.aegis/runtime/serve-headless/instance: Runtime instance scope for headless serve.
canonical_tree.~/.aegis/runtime/serve-headful/instances: Runtime instance scope for headful serve.

file_safety: JSON files are created with default payloads.
Corrupt JSON files are quarantined with .corrupt.<timestamp> suffix and replaced.
Writes use temporary files, sync, atomic rename, and directory sync on Unix.
State file locks use .lock files and flock on Unix.
State files are secured to owner-only 0600 permissions on Unix.

credentials.auto_capture: src/api/server.rs tracks set_value username/password fields and submit-like click/enter, then writes credentials through AegisSecretStore when enabled.
credentials.non_goal: Aegis does not read or write Chrome/Brave cookies, login databases, or Safe Storage entries.

transfers.downloads: Browser downloads go to BrowserConfig.download_dir or ~/.aegis/files/downloads.
transfers.uploads: SetFiles stages files into BrowserConfig.upload_dir or ~/.aegis/files/uploads, sanitizes names, encodes bytes as base64 payloads, then injects File objects in JS.

targets.aegis_native: Standalone CEF app executable or macOS app bundle.
targets.aegis_host: Shared library dynamically loaded by Rust serve runtime.
targets.aegis_shared_support: Static support library for shared native components.

major_flows.name: Start Persistent Runtime
steps: CLI resolves transfer paths and BrowserConfig.
CLI resolves host library from --host-lib, workspace release runtime, or installed app.
serve_main_thread on macOS or async serve on non-macOS starts HTTP API and runtime context.
LoadedHost dynamically loads aegis_host and calls aegis_create_host with BrowserConfig JSON.
AegisCefHost starts or attaches to initialized CEF on the process main thread.
Native creates browser with start URL or bootstrap URL.
AegisApp injects kAegisRuntimeScript into renderer context.
Renderer sends lifecycle context_ready.
Rust snapshots HostRuntimeState and starts pumping.
Readiness and diagnostics become available through /healthz, /readyz, /doctor, and /runtime.

major_flows.name: Navigate
steps: Client sends POST /navigate or /contexts/{id}/navigate with url.
API sends ApiCommand::Navigate through context channel.
AegisRuntime.ensure_runtime_bootstrapped refreshes host state.
CefBridge encodes Navigate request with optional network capture flag.
Native AegisCefHost decodes request, optionally enables DevTools Network capture, calls NavigateTo.
Native returns current URL plus navigation event and local events.
Rust applies events, updates current_url, refreshes host/live state, records trace if enabled.
API returns Vec<SequencedEvent>.

major_flows.name: Execute Command Batch
steps: Client sends POST /execute with Array<Command>.
AegisRuntime assigns batch id.
SetFiles commands are prepared by staging files and adding base64 UploadFilePayloads.
Bridge-compatible commands are flushed to native SendBatch.
wait_for and media_state are executed locally in Rust between bridge flushes.
Native sends SendBatch to renderer operation.
JS exec resolves targets, performs actions, returns per-command results and _aegis event spans.
JS queued events and native local events are merged into response.
Rust applies DOM snapshot or mutations, sequences events, annotates interaction diagnostics, refreshes live state, and records trace.

major_flows.name: Semantic Target Resolution
steps: A command may target a raw node id or a CommandMatcher.
JS matcher search optionally scopes by CSS selector.
Each candidate descriptor is built from allowlisted attrs, text, semantics, visibility, and actions.
Candidate scoring rewards exact/partial field matches, visibility, actionability, action targetability, and native control tags.
Ambiguous equal top scores throw an error.
Rust has a parallel matcher implementation for snapshot-side reasoning and credential capture.

major_flows.name: Session Injection and Snapshot
steps: SessionState validates in Rust.
Bridge sends InjectSession to native.
Native replaces network overrides and cookies, then stores pending storage injection payload.
If renderer is ready, native invokes renderer storage injection; otherwise storage injection is deferred.
SnapshotSession ensures runtime ready, captures document.cookie, asks renderer for storage, appends cookies and network overrides, and returns SessionState.

major_flows.name: Page Research Data
steps: API page endpoints call runtime.page_research_data().
Runtime refreshes live state.
Bridge evals JSON.stringify(window.__aegis.pageResearchData()).

JS extracts title, URL, canonical URL, visible text, content scopes, main content selector, headings, links, primary links, controls, primary controls, forms, overlays, semantic summary, page type, blockers, not-found signals, suggested search query, and suggested next actions.
API transforms this into text, markdown, actions, forms, links, headings, find, and open-link responses.

major_flows.name: Live Event Streaming
steps: Client opens /events/live or context-scoped equivalent.
Server emits ready SSE event.
Loop sends ApiCommand::Events with current since sequence.
Runtime enables network event capture, drains pending events, and reads EventStream.
API filters events by category or exact event name.
Server emits runtime_events SSE only when events exist or a retention gap is detected.

major_flows.name: Trace Recording and Replay
steps: POST /trace/enable sets TraceRecorder with path and current BrowserConfig.
Session injection stores initial session into recorder.
Each navigation or command batch records request, response, and sequenced emitted events.
Trace inspect loads file and replays final snapshot plus event stream without native runtime.

major_flows.name: Download Tracking
steps: Native AegisClient receives OnBeforeDownload.
AegisCefHost chooses unique target under download_dir.
DownloadRecord is inserted into BrowserContextState and emitted as a download RuntimeEvent.
OnDownloadUpdated updates received bytes, total bytes, percent, interrupt reason, complete/canceled state, and emits another download event.
HostRuntimeState exposes downloads; API exposes /downloads.

important_distinctions_to_show: HTTP API is local control surface; C ABI is internal Rust-native bridge.
Native CEF host owns real browser and OS/platform integration.
Injected JS runtime owns semantic page interpretation and command execution.
Rust runtime owns sequencing, diagnostics aggregation, trace recording, and API responses.
Aegis-owned ~/.aegis JSON state is canonical persistence; Chromium profile internals are not.
